Source: Copernicus Climate Change Service (ERA5); Zerodha calculations
Niño 3.4 sea‐surface temperature, three‐month averages against 1991–2020, Copernicus ERA5. El Niño
Each column is one year: how far the central Pacific’s surface was above or below its
normal temperature from July to September. Above the El Niño line it is warm enough to count as an
El Niño; below the La Niña line, cool enough to count as a La Niña.
